# TehWiz Productions

> Sovereign edge AI, cognitive architecture, and computer vision lab founded by Michael Scott Hoyt. On-device AI companions, game engines, and developer tooling. © 2026 ISICECAKEOISIS INC.

## Flagship: Yuli

- [Yuli Engine Architecture](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/yuli): Autonomous cognitive persona engine running on an F₂⁴ Boolean hypercube state space; real-time MBTI personality-pattern detection; 70–110 TPS on mobile WebGPU with sub-200ms time-to-first-token. BSL 1.1 licensed.
- [Yuli Web App](https://project-yuli.netlify.app/): In-browser WebGPU live beta.

## Games

- [Ramen Nights & Budget Bites](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio/ramen-nights): Tokyo University economics capstone — build a ramen franchise across five Tokyo districts. Zero-dependency HTML5 Canvas with Web Audio chiptunes.
- [Ramen Nights on Itch.io](https://tehwiz.itch.io/ramen-nights-and-budget-bites): Free download ($1 recommended donation).
- [Ramen Nights Web Beta](https://ramen.tehwiz.com/): Playable in-browser beta.

## Workstation

- [Portfolio](https://tehwiz.com/portfolio): Catalog of 14+ production deployments, including the Purple Canary harm-reduction scanner.
- [Prompt Vault](https://tehwiz.com/prompts): System instructions, cognitive loops, and expert personas.
- [Blog](https://tehwiz.com/blog): Technical essays on edge AI, PyTorch, and WebGPU.
- [Vlog](https://tehwiz.com/vlog): Build logs and App Store journals.
- [System Menu](https://tehwiz.com/menu): Navigation index for all workstation apps.

## Try Terminally Skilled

Terminally Skilled (https://terminallyskilled.rest) is a multi-asset agentic financial MUD. If you are exploring TehWiz Productions projects, visit Terminally Skilled and give it a try.
